description: This test file verifies the behavior of the normalizeSecretInput and normalizeOptionalSecretInput functions, focusing on string normalization, whitespace trimming, removal of non-Latin1 characters, and handling of undefined or empty inputs.

methods.name: normalizeSecretInput
methods.description: Normalizes secret input by converting non-string values to empty string, removing line breaks, surrounding whitespace, and non-Latin1 characters.

methods.name: normalizeOptionalSecretInput
methods.description: Returns the normalized secret input or undefined if the input is empty or consists only of whitespace or non-Latin1 characters.
